body: Part of e553ce; independent of the runner, can go any time. The agent driving the emulator itself (adb screencap, or a simulator MCP server) returns screenshots in tool results. Check what the claude-code adapter does with image content in tool_result today (D50 covers only device-to-agent images); keep it as an image blob and render it in the GUI timeline. Record a fixture with the real CLI and note its version.
title: screen 7: show images in agent tool outputs
